activities.description: Disabled dad, I worked to help mom pay the bills, little volunteering hours and no in-school leadership positions listed on my application. didn’t do any fancy summer programs, no formal research with a professor. Accepted to a HYPSM. Anything is possible :)

activities.name: I had a major surgery that put me in a wheelchair for some time and forced me to
activities.description: I had a major surgery that put me in a wheelchair for some time and forced me to do online school when I was in high school. Absolutely restricted my ability to do ECs, but my grades were still great. I was admitted to T10s + ivy in my cycle, and I do believe the extenuating circumstances covered for my lackluster ECs.

activities.name: - We’ll never know each year to year how much leniency extenuating circumstances
activities.description: - We’ll never know each year to year how much leniency extenuating circumstances would give to XYZ college. That said, I’ve seen kids who had worse (but not really bad) grades BUT had something else significantly good get into “respectable colleges.”
